<!-- pr-reviewer: 3a6ff68e9562ab28f80a1095dabf829aedd1043d -->

Reviewed on the cheap tier at the maintainer's instruction. This PR adds posted G-code (C rewinds written into the path as real moves) and changes what the machine check accepts for a C travel, so it is under AGENTS.md's safety floor and its review should run at the high tier; treat this pass as a first screen, not the full verdict.

**Verdict: Needs changes before merge** (first screen; the high-tier review is still owed).

### What looks good
- Clear links are strict: a point qualifies only at the path's clearance height or radius, strictly beyond all cut reach (`crates/cl/src/cl/rotary_unwind.rs:77-83`). A path with no rapid has no link and is refused by name.
- Fewest-turns logic considers both travel ends (`rotary_unwind.rs:102-117`); a rewind only moves C back toward the travel.
- Chord count is bounded (`MAX_ORBIT_CHORDS`, `rotary_unwind.rs:155`), the step is clamped, and no unwrap/expect/panic outside tests.
- Travel is read from the machine's rotary named C, the axis `machine::check` judges (`rotary_gate.rs` `c_travel`). An unstated travel leaves the path as stamped.
- The stock-conviction test (`crates/app/tests/c_axis_unwind.rs:180-189`) places stock in the rewind's way and asserts `RapidInStock`.
- Golden: C stays in -360..360 on every block; each ring keeps its 360-degree span; the cut blocks are only shifted by whole turns; no existing golden moved.

### Local results (trial merge with origin/main bdd29e00, head 3a6ff68e)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| camcraft-cl unit tests (incl. rotary_unwind) | 36/36 pass |
| camcraft-cl headless_bin | 3/3 pass |
| app c_axis_unwind | 4/4 pass |
| app c_axis_live | 4/4 pass |
| app rotary_letter | 3/3 pass |
| app machine | 33/33 pass |
| app conformance | 6/6 pass |
| app golden_cl | 25/25 pass |
| clippy -D warnings, camcraft-cl + camcraft-app, all targets | clean |

Not run: the `rotary`/`millturn` name-filter suites beyond those above, the ui suites, the `--ignored` lanes and the release tier.

### Requested before merge
1. **Rewinds are posted as feed moves, not rapids** (`crates/app/tests/golden/nc/fanuc-lathe/c_axis_unwind.nc`). The orbit is `G01 X20 Z5 C-348.75 F22954.2` and the retract is `G01 X20 Z5 C-360 F4000`; no G00 appears after the opening move. The PR body admits the composite rapid feed is unconfirmed on a real control (owed item 5). The orbit feed (about 22,954) also exceeds the stated X/Y/Z feed of 4000. Please either post the clearance rewinds as G00 or refuse the rewind until the feed law is confirmed, and make the machine check or post judge that feed against the stated limits. The test only asserts no warnings, so nothing currently catches this.
2. **Rotary Parallel and Rotary Offset reach the post untested** (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:1221` and `:1307`). Both now pass `machine_rotaries` into `stamp_spindle_c`, so a limited-travel C can now post where it was refused before. Their clearance is the radial retract cylinder (`rmax` branch, `rotary_unwind.rs:82`), which is a different link rule and is not exercised end to end. Please add at least one end-to-end test per op, or refuse these ops on a stated C travel until they are tested.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
- Only C is checked for finiteness (`rotary_unwind.rs:61`); a NaN point coordinate would pass into `r` and the orbit (n collapses to 1). Consider a finite check on the points too.
- The clear-link test assumes `moves[i].from == moves[i-1].to` (`rotary_unwind.rs:87`); no check enforces this chain.
- `generate.rs` is already 3268 lines; this PR adds to it (not blocking, flagged for growth).
- The decisions file (`docs/decisions/33-c-unwind.md`) names the dropped control roll-over alternative. Good.
- Body: `Refs #33`, `Changelog:` present, no closing keyword. Good.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
